projects.name: FPGA playground
projects.description: pvt_lab (ring oscillators, heater, hold loop, TDC, droop monitor) plus the TRNG, both on CM4 UARTs. The public interactive page; pvtd drives it.

uarts.speaks: pvt_lab text lines (R ... H ... M ...), commands + K keepalive
TRNG raw bits; single-byte commands 0-9 C S G

projects.name: pvt-lab v4
projects.description: Standalone PVT lab: 5 ring oscillators, heater with the 2.7 s UART watchdog, fabric hold loop, TDC, droop monitor. Driven from the Mac over JP5 (fpga/pvt-lab/pvt_lab.py); the status line is mirrored to the CM4 read-only.

uarts.speaks: mirror of the JP5 status line

projects.name: TRNG
projects.description: Ring-oscillator true random number generator (16 LUT rings) with SP 800-90B repetition-count and adaptive-proportion health tests on chip. Raw bits stream out of JP5; the CM4 can't see them.

uarts.speaks: raw bits, binary; commands 0-9 C S G (fpga/trng/trng_test.py)

projects.name: LiteX RISC-V SoC (CM4 UART)
projects.description: VexRiscv RV32IM LiteX SoC, 32 KB BRAM, with a second UART on GPIO14/15. Firmware must be built against build-qmtech-k7-cm4's own headers. donut/mandel output is known to garble on this build.

uarts.speaks: LiteX BIOS console (litex_term --serial-boot on the CM4)

projects.name: DDR3 test
projects.description: UberDDR3 controller memory test on the board's DDR3. Results come out of the JP5 UART bridge at 9600 8N1; the CM4 can't see them.
